sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
observationScope: Non-exhaustive connected Drive metadata listing, selected manifest content and folder-level permissions. Unvisited subfolders and file-level rights are not cleared.
precedence: Professor's current art and project decision
Current exact GitHub source and reviewed doctrine
Current private Drive owner/permission and actual-file proof
Legacy handoff docs, labels, historical snapshots

tiers.evidence: Private animated-character collection lists one GIF and one JSON manifest; state manifest describes eight unique states plus repeated idle, 512 by 640, 8 FPS.
tiers.next: Privately verify actual GIF SHA-256, playback frames, creator/rights and UI performance; make a local/private preview candidate; do not replace approved Lum identity.

tiers.evidence: Selected sprite collection lists 27 PNG items, including two palettes and per-frame candidates.
tiers.next: Verify atlas dimensions, transparency, sequence, hash, attribution; private canvas/jQuery sprite-preview lane before approved UI substitution.

tiers.evidence: Originals subtree has one image-art candidate; other Godot vault branches distinguish third-party references and community-source materials.
tiers.next: Inspect candidate image privately as reference; separately locate owned GLB/Blender rig, test Godot import, deformations, WASM/Android WebGL and touch.

tiers.evidence: Private media folder contains a small set of image, vector, animated preview and project script/title-card candidates; folder listing alone cannot establish render completion.
tiers.next: Select one original/approved title or motion candidate for private story/timeline preview; preserve original masters and creator credits.

tiers.evidence: Selected owner-only private production collection contains review/reference subfolders plus unreviewed archive; older read-only audit identified no verified ready 3D models in inspected set.
tiers.next: Keep archive quarantined; match inventory and source receipts to exact private file hashes, then test one approved character/scene privately with Blender/Godot.

tiers.evidence: Dedicated media hierarchy lists eight lifecycle folders for source art, references, audio, video, projects, render intermediates, exports and archives.
tiers.next: Associate protected project masters and outputs with logical ID and private hash ledger; do not assume folder names contain finished binaries.

firstVerticalSlice.desiredOutcome: An actual Drive-sourced Lum animation candidate plays inside a private seven-layer studio preview with source hash, attribution and fallback
